etymology.historical_story: As a given name, Lewis is a medieval English form of Louis, ultimately connected with a Germanic personal name associated with fame and battle. Surnames spelled Lewis can have several histories, including Welsh connections. That variety explains why a name's spelling alone cannot establish the ancestry of an individual bearer.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Lewis常读作“卢—伊斯”，分两拍记住；看到末尾s也把它作为完整姓名记忆。
